DiagramService
|-- Sole content-writing interface
|   |-- create(input); revise(baseRevisionId, edit); generate(request, options?)
|   `-- Callers receive a prepared edit plus its issued revision.
|-- RevisionedDiagramService issues local revisions
|   |-- Calls DiagramRevisionEditor.prepareCreate(...) or prepareEdit(...).
|   |-- private issue(prepared, base?)
|   |   `-- Registers nodeRefs, preserving mapped identities from the base.
|   `-- Unchanged edits reuse the base; revisions retain diagramId.
|-- Revision lookup uses the imported registry
|   |-- getRevision(revisionId); listRevisions(diagramId)
|   `-- diagramRevisions retains records; its lifetime owner is unspecified.
`-- Generation uses an optional injected DiagramGenerator
    |-- generator.generate(structuredClone(request), options)
    |-- Checks abort and base identity; then calls revise or create.
    `-- DiagramGenerationRequest: input, instruction, agentContext?, context?, baseRevisionId?
